name: South Mumbai Heritage Walk by MDT
description:
The Mumbai Heritage Walk is a great way to experience the city’s vibrant culture and rich history.
Mumbai Heritage Walk is probably known as the ‘dream city’ and rightly so the city is indeed like a beautiful, magnificent dream. Old Mumbai is the part of Mumbai that represents its heritage and history. Reflecting on the time of Colonial era, the area is studded with numerous tourist attractions. From Chhatrapati Shivaji terminus to the ‘White town’ to the University library to the magnificent Marine drive, the city has so many spectacular attractions that one can never miss. Explore all these places of Old Mumbai and many more with this heritage walk tour.

Walking tours expose many residents and visitors to the structures.

At the time of sale, the sales team guaranteed lifetime open views, only for Avant to start constructing another building right in front of our flat — completely blocking the view. This is nothing but mis-selling and deception.
The sales and CRM teams are full of false promises. From day one, my buying journey has been pathetic, mentally exhausting, and filled with half-truths and broken commitments.
The so-called “premium” standards are laughable:
Lobby height is shockingly low — older buildings look more premium than this.
Flat was sold as Vastu compliant, but professional Vastu analysis showed only 20% compliance.
Construction quality and planning are far below expectations for a brand like Avant.
This builder clearly prioritizes sales over honesty and delivery. Once they get your money, you’re left chasing timelines, clarity, and basic transparency.
⚠️ Strong warning:
If you value peace of mind, transparency, and getting what you’re promised — stay away from Avant Heritage. This is not a premium builder experience, it’s a premium nightmare.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I went batting!

For the uninitiated, it means bat watching! Mumbai's first bat watching walk was held by Naturalist Explorers at the Mahakali Caves. It was conducted by a very learned researcher on bats - Raj Kumar Patil.

And it was fascinating!

Bats are such incredible creatures - some species eat fruits and help pollinate certain plants and actually help keep a forest alive.

For example, did you know that we wouldn't have tequila today if a certain species of bats in North America didn't pollinate the agave plant crucial for tequila production?

In India, for example, bats pollinate the wild banana plant.

Some bat species are insectivores and save mankind billions of dollars in pesticides.

Bat poop or guano is very rich in nitrogen and is highly sought after in Southeast Asia as a fertiliser. India, somehow, hasn't started using this as fertiliser as yet.

Bats communicate using ultrasonic sound waves and use the echoes to detect different surfaces and their prey - insects. Moths - their prey - have figured out how to emit the same frequencies and use it to jam the bats' frequencies frustrating the bats' efforts! And the bats have retaliated by emitting sounds very rapidly which freeze the moths! What an incredible way species adapt to each other!

And we spotted a bat species - Schneider's leaf nose bat - identified through the frequency of its calls. And we watched fascinated as it constantly emitted calls and furiously moved its ears to catch the echoes and detect surfaces and its prey. Special thermal heat generating cameras were used by the researcher to detect it and particular equipment for detecting ultrasonic sound was used to capture its calls.

What a privilege it was to watch this little bat in action. I am very grateful that I had this opportunity.

Of course, one must always take precautions and not make loud sounds and sudden movements and touch bats to avoid being bitten. Also, to prevent the spread of the Nipah virus, one should avoid nibbled on fruits and todi and neera - where fruit bats and their saliva and other fluids can get into during the process of extraction from the trees.

Such an important and fascinating and misunderstood creature - the bat - I hope to go on more such bat walks and learn more about them. Naturalist Explorers did a wonderful job of educating us. Join a bat walk too with them if you can!

Nature truly is the greatest storyteller. featured_reviews.review_text:
HEAVEN FOR REAL #Letsgo

14/12/2017-17/12/2017
The best decision of joining the Digital Detoxification trip by Let’s Go Outdoors
I never knew that such a beautiful world exists until I decided to go for digital detox with let's go and explored the mesmerizing beauties of nature.
My first ever trip.
Uttarakhand,Jim Corbett

Meeting a group of unknown people who are no more unknown to me.
Traveling on beautiful roads of Delhi to Uttarakhand.
Reaching Jim Corbett and then walking towards Eco Resort for 45mins brought butterflies in my stomach of every surprise on the way. Crossing the river on a small raft made me happy like a kid.
Cool breeze hitting my face,sound of the river and birds made me feel so close to the nature. There I see the beautiful place where we will stay in the middle  of the forest welcoming me with wide open arms to experience the most amazing next 2days of my life.
Never thought mornings can be so beautiful in the forests and mountains where all you see is loving nature.
The lovely staff of the resort made us extremely happy by the service provided. The yummiest and healthy food they served and how can I forget the smiles on their faces after seeing us happy.
The experience of star gazing, bird watching, spotting animals like barking deer, sambar, lungurs, brown fish owl, vultures and many more. Sitting near the river side made me realise we are so unaware about our beautiful places and nature in our country. But not any more. I promised myself sitting near the river that I want to see more, learn more and LIVE MORE.
Today this is a ‘SUPER HAPPY ME’ after realising that we really must leave our phones and all the gadgets aside and live and enjoy the beautiful experiences, which cannot be captured by any camera of this world. It can only be felt.
In the end I am so grateful to Sandesh for taking me to such a beautiful place.
Memories for life☺

featured_reviews.name: Derishta Pillay
featured_reviews.review_text:
At the outset I must say that neither myself nor my husband are huge fans of the usual guided walking tours mainly because we hate being taken to cliched and crowded tourist hotspots, listening to facts straight from the Wikipedia page and jostling for space with other tourists just to return sunburned and underwhelmed. In addition we'd already spent a hectic 5 weeks in India - we were tired, grumpy, waiting to fly back home and not at all looking forward to our last 4 days in Mumbai at all. So basically when our travel companions insisted we book a tour - the scene was set for disaster...
'Bombay Walks' single handedly turned this around and Mumbai actually turned out to be the highlight of our trip! (Nope this is not a sponsored review 😂)

The tour: Arpan's tour extends to the days before and after the actual tour as he offers valuable advice about where to stay/eat/party/shop etc. He speaks perfect English, is pleasant and very easy to communicate with. His passion and love for the city is infectious and you will end his tour enthralled, overwhelmed and completely charmed by Mumbai and it's people - vowing to come back and dig deeper, spend longer and see more. The city tour covers many facets of the city - traveling to hidden gems and local landmarks across the length and breadth of Mumbai. You get to see and experience aspects of Mumbai that you'd never be able to do alone with a guide book or google maps - like traveling on local trains and walking through Worli fishing village and stopping by at small off-the-beaten path temples and churches.

The guide: Arpan is reliable, trustworthy and comes well prepared for the type of group. His talking style is light-hearted and easy going but still knowledgeable and always engaging. He's the type of guide that can tell you interesting facts about the history, architecture and politics of a place but also where to get the best coconut water along the way and which public toilets are ok to use.
We only met Arpan in person on the day of the tour and although we were constantly bombarded with sights, sounds and smells (it is Mumbai after all) - it never once felt like we were just being dragged from point to point whilst he rattled off information but rather that we were spending the day walking around with an old friend.

Target travelers: We're fairly well travelled and yet this is the first time we've ever bothered to leave a tour review - on any platform - I think that in itself indicates how highly we recommend this tour.
This is really a 'must do' in Mumbai.
It's so good we would do this tour again even if it were to cover the exact route we already took. The walking wasn't particular strenuous so it's recommended for any age group it should also be noted that we found that     Arpan was discreetly always conscious of where the group members were and their safety and constantly aware of our surroundings and the locals around us - on that note I would recommend this tour even if you're a single female traveling alone.

When to do it: Try and do this tour on your first full day in Mumbai because it's also a great way to orientate yourself around the city and plan the rest of your time there.

That city that everyone talks about - that's all of India's many faces and layers in one, that accepts everyone, that's everyone's home - regardless of language, religion or creed - Mumbai is THAT city and you'd be crazy if you miss the opportunity to let a born-and-bred local guide you around...

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an absolutely wonderful experience with Wisdom Travel and Tours. Our Thailand trip was truly memorable and beautifully planned.

The hotel locations were thoughtfully chosen, keeping us close to markets and great dining options, which made exploring so convenient.

A special thanks to Rizaan for patiently understanding our preferences and incorporating every valuable suggestion into a perfectly curated itinerary. The entire experience was seamless, well-organized, and offered excellent value for money.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a stress-free and thoughtfully planned holiday!

featured_reviews.name: Farid Pirani
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you so much to the team at Wisdom Travel and Tours and shoutout to Mayur and Sohail for organizing our trip across Europe. They handled everything from hotel bookings to airport transfers and even small details and tips during excursions. Their attention to detail was great, we didn’t have to go hunting for how to get around the city or where to book tickets. They were also very responsive anytime we had any additional questions or needed any help before or during the trip. I highly recommend them and will reach out again in the future for our next vacation.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for the kind words! We are glad to hear that you find the booking process easier and more convenient. It's always a pleasure to help with your travel needs. Looking forward to assisting you and your family for future trips!

featured_reviews.name: Ali Rupani
featured_reviews.review_text: Mr Mayur and the team were exceptional before and during our trip to India.  Every element of our family vacation to India was handled precisely without us ever having to worry.  Look forward to using Wisdom again in the near future.

featured_reviews.name: Jasmin Punjani
featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Tanusha Chakravarty
featured_reviews.review_text: We have been using their travel services for years, and every trip has been perfectly planned. They take care of everything—flights, accommodation, itineraries, and even the small details that make a big difference. Their experience really shows in how smoothly everything runs. Special thanks to Mayur and Sohail for their excellent support and attention to detail. Highly recommended for anyone who wants a stress-free and well-organized travel experience.

featured_reviews.name: mrunal rane
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently I, along with my family members visited Thailand (Phuket, Krabi, Pattaya, Bangkok) through Wisdom Travels. We had great time. Thank you to the team for making arragments from Air tickets, hotel accomodation, transfer and all sight seeing booking. Everyting was taken care. We also got great support at Thailand from tour operator to drivers. Good going Wisdom Travel. Keep it up. Thanks to Yugal for keeping in touch and sending me all the details including our boarding passes well before time.

featured_reviews.name: R Jayaprakash
featured_reviews.review_text:
Four of us visited Georgia by a tour organised by Wisdom in May 2025. Georgia is a wonderful place with beautiful sceneries and ancient churches. It’s very tourist friendly and very economical place to visit for Indian tourists

Wisdom made faultless arrangements for us. From the time we landed in Tbilisi everything was taken care of. There was a driver to pick us up and take us to our hotel. He took us to various tourist spots, churches and winery during the next four days. Everything went with clockwork precision. We wonder how the tour would’ve been without the services of Wisdom. Our heartfelt congratulations to Wisdom.
We flew by a budget airline Jazeera Airways. We had expressed our concerns about the less known airlines but Wisdom assured that it would be fine. And it was. Except that the seating a bit cramped, the airline was very good for a budget airline.
A word of caution for travellers to Georgia: Very few people can speak English. Signboards are mostly in Georgian. But people are friendly.
